notes.title: Release on the 17th of september!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to share with you that Repent will release on the 17th of September!. That's only a couple of weeks away!. 
We can't wait to see your reaction to what we have been cooking up until now!.

As always thanks for your support, see you soon!.
